title: Subprocess Pipe Transport Lifecycle & Windows Proactor Guard

claims.assertion: Asynchronous subprocesses executed under asyncio ProactorEventLoop on Windows raise unraisable ResourceWarnings during garbage collection if pipe transports remain unclosed.
SubprocessExecutor must explicitly drain and close stdin, stdout, and stderr pipe transports inside finally blocks.
Rule 14 mandates clean pipe transport disposal for all sandboxed execution layers.

context: Knowledge item ki_self_20260828_06: Subprocess Pipe Transport Lifecycle & Windows Proactor Guard
distilled_learning:
### Distilled Heuristic
All asynchronous subprocess sandbox transports must explicitly drain and close stdin/stdout/stderr pipes inside finally blocks to guarantee clean proactor resource disposal and eliminate unraisable ResourceWarnings across operating systems.
